storage: Keep in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard; crush or grind only what is needed.
looksLike: Small, round, wrinkled, dark brown-black berries about 4 to 5 mm across, hard and with a sharp, woody aroma when crushed.
howToPick: Choose heavy, dark, evenly sized, well-wrinkled berries with a sharp smell when rubbed; avoid pale, light, dusty or mouldy berries and any with a stale smell (light berries can be 'pinheads', immature berries).
shelfLife: About 2 to 3 years in a sealed container, longer than ground pepper (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)

usedIn.raw: 3 corns per serving (about 0.1 g, in the whole-spice tempering)
